SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_dispatch d
AND d.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskName}, '%')
AND d.status = #{status}

SELECT m.user_id AS userId, u.real_name AS realName, u.emp_no AS empNo, u.dept_name AS deptName, u.phone AS phone, m.create_time AS createTime FROM flow_task_member m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY m.id ASC
